entities.title: Work on Hivestorm
entities.summary: Install, test and build the game in its folder.
steps: npm test (typecheck, then the test suites)
npm run build (into dist/games/retro/hivestorm/, with _headers at dist/; BASE_PATH="" builds at the root)
npm run dev rebuilds on change; serve dist/ with any static server

entities.title: Change the database
entities.summary: A schema change is a migration applied by hand before merging.
steps: Add games/hivestorm/worker/migrations/NNNN-what-it-does.sql, numbered from 0002 (Hivestorm has none yet), with a comment saying why
Make the same change in worker/schema.sql
Try it locally: npx wrangler d1 execute hivestorm-scores --local --file worker/migrations/<file>
Apply it to production before merging, and say so in the pull request's description
